features.chain: Player+0x124 uint32mask0x40; Player+0x8C8 uint32mask0x1000; Player+0x908 nativepointer must0
features.abi: Native equivalents: void __fastcall Enable(Player,void*override=null) at3CBFC0; void __fastcall Clear(Player) at3CC3B0. Bridge implements identical masked writes.
features.scene_gates: StableSceneLiving, unattached, both bits initiallyclear, overridepointer0. Bind actor/status/scheduler/10byte room.
features.restore: Clear only the two owned bits when the same actor/status/scheduler/room and null override pointer still match. Scene or actor replacement automatically disables the trainer toggle. Foreign changes are preserved; old actor memory is never touched.

evidence.Finding: Four-instruction setters OR/AND Actor+0x124 mask0x40 and+0x8C8 mask0x1000; Actor+0x908 override pointer. VM53E840 calls Enable(actor,null).
evidence.Level: Fresh decompile and full setter/clearer assembly verified; synthetic restoration tests passed.

evidence.Finding: Actor+0x124 bit0x40 selects movement path that bypasses the collision resolver; +0x8C8 bit0x1000 also affects spatial partition checks.
evidence.Level: Native branch inspected. Live movement behavior not yet tested.

tests: 57 total Player/Bridge checks; 10 collision cases cover native override, preexisting bit, invalid toggle, exact fields, unrelated bit preservation, foreign pointer/partial edit, actor replacement, same-actor teardown and new room.

damage_research.separate_path: 3C0FF0 also scales direct damage; patching only3C12F0 would not be complete invulnerability.
excluded_features: No unverified damage multiplier, enemy one-hit-kill, or direct form-ID assignment. Movement collision bypass is implemented with narrow field ownership.
damage_research.hp_floor_hazard: Status+8 minimumHP is mirrored to global RVA2A23960 by3C2120 and back by3C1D90. A naive temporary floor write can leak across actor changes. AutoHeal deliberately does not alter this floor.

movement_research.position_setter: RVA3B6100 setsActor.flags120|200000; writes localXYZ+670 andW1; calls3CCB90; mayclear motionaccumulators+0xD24/+0xD2C.
movement_research.parenting: Actor packedparent+6A0; getter3B5B40 selects worldmatrixtranslation+70 whenattached, elselocal+670.
movement_research.speed: Actorfloat+130 is only fallback. 3B5A40 can replace it with abilitytable values via401680/3E92D0. Direct speedfield edits would be unreliable.
movement_research.bookmark: Actor+status+gamescheduler+10-byte currenttarget717008; invalidate after any observed transition/unready/change.

gauge_hazards: 3C2020 fullDrive also clears form/summon timer floats. Bridge uses validated Drive bytes only in mode1.
3C0B50 positive timer change flips sign whenActorformID6 and awards summonEXP on crossedbars inmode3. Timerrefillusesvalidateddirectfloatcopy.
Form3E8380 grants growth/rewardabilities; directformlevelwrites would skipthese.
Summon40D530 honors owned-Summon-charms cap40D680, grantsrewardabilities andrefreshesstatus; directlevelwrites would skipthese.
